referents.why: 'Who is this who obscures My counsel' asks about the one addressed; the speech is to Job, so 'this' is Job (masc sing).
referents.category: question word with the addressee as referent

links.why: The bare participle 'making dark' follows the finite question clause and describes its subject as it acts: who is this one obscuring my counsel.
'not knowledge' is a clause nested in the phrase 'by words' (words without knowledge); the link carries the role of modifier of the instrument.
